mapper.select: SELECT ea.employee_id AS employeeId, ea.employment_period_id AS employmentPeriodId, employee.company_id AS companyId FROM employment_assignment ea JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = ea.employee_id WHERE ea.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ea.current_version_marker = 1 AND ea.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ea.effective_from <= #{at} AND (ea.effective_to IS NULL OR ea.effective_to > #{at})
SELECT alpv.annual_leave_policy_version_id FROM annual_leave_policy_version alpv WHERE alpv.company_id = #{companyId} AND alpv.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY alpv.version_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ta.time_account_id AS accountId, ta.employee_id AS employeeId, ta.employment_period_id AS employmentPeriodId, ta.company_id AS companyId, ta.account_year AS year, ta.balance_hours AS balanceHours, ta.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId, ta.row_version AS rowVersion FROM time_account ta WHERE ta.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ta.employment_period_id = #{employmentPeriodId} AND ta.account_type = 'ANNUAL_LEAVE' AND ta.account_year = #{year}

SELECT ta.time_account_id AS accountId, ta.employee_id AS employeeId, ta.employment_period_id AS employmentPeriodId, ta.company_id AS companyId, ta.account_year AS year, ta.balance_hours AS balanceHours, ta.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId, ta.row_version AS rowVersion FROM time_account ta WHERE ta.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ta.employment_period_id = #{employmentPeriodId} AND ta.account_type = 'ANNUAL_LEAVE' AND ta.account_year = #{year} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO time_account ( time_account_id, employee_id, employment_period_id, company_id, account_type, account_year, balance_hours, policy_version_id, row_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{employeeId}, #{employmentPeriodId}, #{companyId}, 'ANNUAL_LEAVE', #{year}, 0.00, #{policyVersionId}, 0, #{now}, #{now} )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reserved_hours), 0.00) FROM oa_time_account_reservation WHERE time_account_id = #{accountId} AND reservation_status IN ('RESERVED', 'CONFIRMED')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS entryCount, COALESCE(SUM(amount_hours), 0.00) AS totalHours FROM time_account_ledger_entry WHERE time_account_id = #{accountId} AND source_type = 'HR_OPENING_IMPORT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_account_ledger_entry ( time_account_ledger_entry_id, time_account_id, sequence_no, entry_type, amount_hours, source_type, source_id, business_date, effective_from, expires_on, policy_version_id, period_version_id, close_snapshot_id, request_id, reversal_of_entry_id, actor_id, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{entryId}, #{accountId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{entryType}, #{amountHours}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{businessDate}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{expiresOn}, #{policyVersionId}, NULL, NULL, #{requestId}, NULL, #{actorId}, #{occurredAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT e.time_account_ledger_entry_id AS entryId, e.time_account_id AS accountId, e.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, e.entry_type AS entryType, e.amount_hours AS amountHours, e.source_type AS sourceType, e.source_id AS sourceId, e.business_date AS businessDate, e.effective_from AS effectiveFrom, e.expires_on AS expiresOn, e.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId, e.request_id AS requestId, e.actor_id AS actorId, e.occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM time_account_ledger_entry e WHERE e.time_account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY e.sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO annual_leave_balance_idempotency_record ( annual_leave_balance_idempotency_record_id, principal_id, idempotency_key, operation, request_digest, claim_token, time_account_id, record_status, resulting_ledger_entry_id, resulting_balance_hours, resulting_row_version, created_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{recordId}, #{principalId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{operation}, #{requestDigest}, #{claimToken}, #{accountId}, 'PROCESSING', NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE annual_leave_balance_idempotency_record_id = annual_leave_balance_idempotency_record_id
mapper.select: SELECT annual_leave_balance_idempotency_record_id AS recordId, principal_id AS principalId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, operation, request_digest AS requestDigest, claim_token AS claimToken, time_account_id AS accountId, record_status AS recordStatus, resulting_ledger_entry_id AS resultingLedgerEntryId, resulting_balance_hours AS resultingBalanceHours, resulting_row_version AS resultingRowVersion, created_at AS createdAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM annual_leave_balance_idempotency_record WHERE principal_id = #{principalId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability granted_capability ON granted_capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND granted_capability.capability_code = #{capability} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id JOIN employee emp ON (data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = emp.company_id) OR (data_scope.scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM employment_assignment ea2 WHERE ea2.employee_id = emp.employee_id AND ea2.organization_id = data_scope.organization_id AND ea2.current_version_marker = 1 )) WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND emp.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND role_assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at}) )
